channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kenyon Martin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kenyon Martin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey
item.description:
“… I grew up, obviously, in Jersey, obviously it was so much easier for me to get New Jersey Nets tickets and see Kenyon Martin, Vince Carter, Jason Kidd, but my family has always had such respect and love for the Knicks and my father having ties to the Knicks, it was kind of guaranteed I was going to fall into this world of being a Knicks fan growing up.”

Madison Square Garden on Vince Carter, Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, New Jersey, May 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kenyon Martin, Rashad McCants
item.description:
Green already had responded to Martin's shots directed at Green himself earlier in the same podcast.

“But one thing I want to share with Kenyon Martin and Rashad McCants,”

Draymond Green on Kenyon Martin, Rashad McCants, Nov 22, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: George Karl on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
George Karl on Kenyon Martin:

“It made me sad… It disappoints me that I can get a person that angry…I want to love my players. I want to care for my players but I am also the leader and the policeman of my team… I thought Kenyon Martin was one of the brightest, defensive players I’ve ever coached, and I thought he would make a hell of a coach.”

George Karl on Kenyon Martin, Jun 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @FanDuelTV.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill
item.description:
Damian Lillard:

“When I came in the league, like Jason Kidd was starting for the Knicks and Grant Hill and Kurt Thomas and Kenyon Martin…it was real older dudes in the league,”

Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill, Mar 14, 2023. Source: Uproxx.

item.title: LeBron James on Kenyon Martin, Gary Trent, Gary Trent Jr
item.description:
LeBron:

“You know you're getting old when you've played against the dad and the son. I've played against the Junior and the Senior. Gary Trent Jr/Sr, Kenyon Martin Jr/Sr.If I get to a third, I swear to god”

LeBron James on Kenyon Martin, Gary Trent, Gary Trent Jr, Jun 6, 2021. Source: reddit.

item.title: George Karl on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
When asked if he regretted how he phrased anything, Karl said

“I think the one thing is (the) fatherhood (comments). Fatherhood is very important to me, and I made that a target. It seems like that was the one thing, andI said it poorly, I wrote it poorly, it’s read poorly in the book. And my whole thing is the one thing I regret probably most is some of the mothers (being offended). Kenyon Martin’s mother is one of the great mothers, superstar mothers of the NBA, and I would never want to take anything away from some of the special families and also special mothers.”

George Karl on Kenyon Martin, Jan 10, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: George Karl on Carmelo Anthony, Kenyon Martin
item.description:
Karl wrote Anthony and Martin not having fathers in their lives became a detriment to their personalities.

“Kenyon and Carmelo carried two big burdens: all that money and no father to show them how to act like a man,”

George Karl on Carmelo Anthony, Kenyon Martin, Dec 22, 2016. Source: New York Post.

item.title: John Hammond on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
In a corresponding roster move,the Bucks also requested waivers on forward Kenyon Martin.

“We thank Kenyon for his contributions on the court and in the locker room,”

John Hammond on Kenyon Martin, Feb 19, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Kidd on his rapport with Martin:

“When I got to Jersey, we've always been close. We've kept that relationship throughout.”

Jason Kidd on Kenyon Martin, Jan 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
Jared Zwerling:Mike Woodson on Kenyon Martin:

“We're still talking to Kenyon. Kenyon is still majorly in our picture.”

Mike Woodson on Kenyon Martin, Jul 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @JaredZwerling.

item.title: Glen Grunwald on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
Al Iannazzone:Grunwald on Kenyon Martin:

“Kenyon is getting our full consideration as we look at what options we have [up front].”

Glen Grunwald on Kenyon Martin, Jul 11, 2013. Source: Twitter @Al_Iannazzone.

item.title: George Karl on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
In a recent conversation with HOOPSWORLD, Karl expressed his surprise that former Nuggets power forward Kenyon Martin has not yet found a team to play with this season.

“I don’t think there’s any question that Kenyon Martin is an NBA player,”

George Karl on Kenyon Martin, Dec 5, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Jarrett Jack on Kenyon Martin, Carl Landry
item.description:
Jarrett Jack:

“Carl Landry is instant offense off the bench. We tried to get him to dig in a little more on defense, but he’ll figure it out. He sat next to me in the locker room, and he’s a great dude. I think he’d fit in well with the group.… We’d have to keep the leash attached, but Kenyon (Martin) is my guy.”

Jarrett Jack on Kenyon Martin, Carl Landry, Jul 13, 2012. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
“It became clear later, but I saw the direction everything was going there with ownership. They were taking it apart. It started with the Kenyon Martin trade and it kept going.”

Jason Kidd on Kenyon Martin, Jun 7, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: George Karl on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
Asked when Martin will be cleared, Nuggets coach George Karl said,

“Around the All-Star break, maybe after the All-Star break. I think Kenyon’s minutes will go up a little bit more. I don’t know if Bird will get there, but I think Kenyon will be cleared to go on back-to-backs.”

George Karl on Kenyon Martin, Feb 3, 2011. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: George Karl on Kenyon Martin
item.description:
“I'm shocked. Ty Lawson and Arron Afflalo are coming up as really good players. We won 53 games and had some pretty serious bombs go off from my health to Kenyon Martin's health. I think Melo is a very mature pro right now. He's had a great camp. He knows that us keeping him is a possibility, and my job is to make it the possibility.”

George Karl on Kenyon Martin, Oct 17, 2010. Source: Denver Post.
